mostWorthwhile.text: The giant impact and subsequent gathering of the Moon made a vast event feel connected to the changing shore, with a useful acknowledgement that impact details remain debated.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding water to the rain-filled hollows was a fairly predictable intermediate step, though the clarification about existing basins made the preceding result worthwhile.

surprise.text: Rain collected in existing hollows rather than immediately making an ocean; the distinction between rain gathering and excavating ocean basins sharpened my understanding.

arbitrary.text: Stone crust plus mist producing rain was not entirely intuitive, although the later collection sequence made its purpose clear.

continue.text: Yes. The progression from impact to Moon to tides was satisfying, and the careful scientific qualifications make me curious how the living world unfolds.
